uncertain: Ridge check: with 96.3 px/m (wall 199..927 = 7.56 m, confirmed by the door and window sizes printed on the plan) the apex row 109 is 5.74 m above the floor row 661, while the section prints +5,53. The floor row is fixed by the 2.20 m terrace doors and the 2.10 m entrance door, so the render draws the roof top about 0.2 m higher than the section's number (ridge tiles and roof build-up, or a render inaccuracy); the row is given as seen.

The page names the pictures frontowa / ogrodowa / boczna / boczna. By the plan 'ogrodowa' (one 240/140 window) is the side opposite the entrance, i.e. REAR; the terrace with the two 160/220 doors is on the RIGHT side, which the page calls only 'boczna'.
Hip roof: on LEFT and RIGHT the short ridge runs x 590..710 (LEFT) and x 645..767 (RIGHT); on FRONT and REAR only the hip apex is seen.
RIGHT: the timber-clad panel between the two terrace doors (x 600..809) is wall cladding, not an opening.
Window boxes are the frames; brick-slip panels above and below the windows and the trim around the door are decoration.
The section is published only as a 400x300 picture; the level figures +5,53, +2,56, -0,32 and the room height 289 are legible on it.
